GreetingConfig.title: GreetingConfig
GreetingConfig.description: Configuration for the 3D Christmas greeting card including headline lines, letter paragraphs, signature, and photo count.

headline1.description: First line of the 3D particle headline greeting.

headline2.description: Second line of the 3D particle headline greeting.

letter.description: Full text of the Christmas letter, with paragraphs separated by double newlines.

sign.description: Signature at the bottom of the letter.

photoCount.description: Total number of photos hanging on the Christmas tree (1 to 12).

bgm.description: Background music track preset ID, audio URL, or base64 audio data URL.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created or manages the configuration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

TreePhoto.title: TreePhoto
TreePhoto.description: Individual photo ornament hanging on the 3D Christmas tree.

greetingId.description: ID of the parent GreetingConfig document.

order.description: Zero-based index of the photo on the tree (0 to 11).

caption.description: Caption displayed below the photo when opened.

src.description: Base64 JPEG data URL of the compressed square photo.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who uploaded the photo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the photo document was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrator record keyed by user UID.

/greetings/{greetingId}.description: Stores the main 3D Christmas card greeting configuration.

/greetings/{greetingId}/photos/{photoId}.description: Stores individual hanging photos belonging to a greeting configuration.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores administrator UIDs for role-based access control.
